verdict.rationale: Reducto mentions a batch queue for Parse and Extract jobs, with a 20% usage discount. Async job submission via run_job, which returns a job ID, plus Svix webhooks with retries also support high-volume, many-document processing. However, the batch queue appears only in a pricing note, with no documentation of how to submit or manage many items in a single bulk operation. Missing for 10: documented batch submission API/mechanics, bulk operations via CLI/MCP across many files, limits/concurrency details, independent hands-on corroboration of bulk processing.
